_ordering_rationale: AMETEK = conglomerat instruments electroniques. 2 segments: EIG (Electronic Instruments Group) ~67% CA + EMG (Electromechanical Group) ~33%. Marges premium ~30%.

kpis.signal: Coeur AMETEK ~67% CA, instruments analytiques/process aerospace/power/industriels, croissance via M&A bolt-on
kpis.description_fr: Segment EIG (Electronic Instruments Group): instruments analyse, monitoring emissions, spectrometres, mesures niveau. Marche aerospace, power, industriels. Croissance soutenue M&A bolt-on.
kpis.description_en: EIG (Electronic Instruments Group): analytical instruments, emission monitors, spectrometers, level measurement. Aerospace, power, industrial markets. Sustained growth via bolt-on M&A.

kpis.signal: 33% CA, motion control + heat exchangers + sondes thermique, croissance acceleree 2024
kpis.description_fr: Segment EMG (Electromechanical Group): solutions motion control, moteurs brushless, blowers/pumps, echangeurs thermiques. ~33% CA. Croissance 2024 +16% via acquisitions.
kpis.description_en: EMG (Electromechanical Group): motion control solutions, brushless motors, blowers/pumps, heat exchangers. ~33% revenue. 2024 +16% growth via acquisitions.

kpis.signal: Marge EIG 30.7% FY24, expansion continue via Operational Excellence
kpis.description_fr: Resultat operationnel segment EIG. Marge 30.7% FY24 vs 28.4% FY23. Expansion continue tiree par Operational Excellence et acquisitions accretives.
kpis.description_en: EIG segment operating income. 30.7% margin FY24 vs 28.4% FY23. Continuous expansion via Operational Excellence and accretive M&A.

kpis.signal: Marge EMG 20% FY24 en baisse 5pts vs FY23, integration acquisitions et mix volume
kpis.description_fr: Resultat operationnel segment EMG. Marge 20% FY24, en baisse 5pts vs FY23 (25%). Integration acquisitions Paragon Medical et mix volume.
kpis.description_en: EMG segment operating income. 20% margin FY24, down 5pts vs FY23 (25%). Integration of Paragon Medical acquisition and volume mix.

kpis.signal: Recurrent +5% CAGR via M&A + organique, record absolu FY24
kpis.description_fr: Chiffre d'affaires total consolide. Record FY24 a 6,941 M$. Croissance +53% sur 5 ans via M&A bolt-on et acquisitions strategiques.
kpis.description_en: Total consolidated net sales. FY24 record at $6,941M. +53% growth over 5 years via bolt-on M&A and strategic acquisitions.
